gloss: labor cost; processing fee; wages for work

definitions.gloss: labor cost; processing fee; wages for work done
definitions.explanation: The charge for labor or craftsmanship in manufacturing, repair, or processing work. Distinct from material costs, this covers the cost of the human work involved.

examples.japanese: {工賃|こうちん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{別途|べっと}→別途：11881_betto⟧⟦かかります→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: There will be a separate labor charge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部品代|ぶひんだい}→部品代：26161_buhindai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{工賃|こうちん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧{一万円|いちまんえん}だった。
examples.english: The parts and labor together came to 10,000 yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{工賃|こうちん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧もの⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧。
examples.english: The labor cost for this repair is so high that it might be better to buy a new one.

notes:
Commonly encountered when getting things repaired or custom-made. On invoices and estimates, {工賃|こうちん} is typically listed separately from ⟦{材料費|ざいりょうひ}→材料費：11512_zairyouhi⟧ (material costs) or ⟦{部品代|ぶひんだい}→部品代：26161_buhindai⟧ (parts costs).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {工賃|こうちん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: labor costs are incurred
- {工賃|こうちん}⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧: labor included (in the price)
- {工賃|こうちん}⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧: labor charged separately
- {工賃|こうちん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支払|しはら}う→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧: to pay the labor charge

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {手間賃|てまちん}: fee for labor/effort — more informal, emphasizes the trouble or effort involved
- ⟦{人件費|じんけんひ}→人件費：20616_jinkenhi⟧: personnel costs — broader term for all costs related to employing people
- {加工賃|かこうちん}: processing fee — specifically for the cost of processing or manufacturing
